activity.label: Brewing
activity.description: Brewing potions using a brewing stand.
activity.rationale: Core activity covering potion ingredients, bottles, and nether wart.

activity.label: Building
activity.rationale: Broad activity covering all structural and decorative blocks.

equip_slot.label: Head

food_category.label: Fish

food_category.label: Fruit

food_use.label: Hunger Restoration
food_use.rationale: Primary purpose of most food items.

food_use.label: Taming
food_use.description: Used to tame or breed animals.
food_use.rationale: Bones, fish, and other taming items.

food_use.label: Trading
food_use.description: Used as currency or trade item with villagers.
food_use.rationale: Emeralds are the main currency, but many food items are traded.

form.label: Armor Piece
form.description: Wearable armor for a specific slot.

form.label: Block
form.description: Places a block in the world.

form.label: Music Disc
form.description: Disc that plays music in a jukebox.

form.label: Weapon
form.rationale: Swords, bows, and axes primarily used for combat.
